name: MerKit Theme Builder and Template Library for Elementor
author: Hoja

sections.description:
MerKit Addons for Elementor gives you a full Theme Builder and a growing Template Library — completely free, forever.

Key Features

Theme Builder (no Pro required)

  • Build custom Headers and Footers with Elementor’s drag-and-drop editor
  • Flexible display conditions: show templates site-wide, on specific pages, post types, archives, or the 404 page
  • Works with any theme that supports standard WordPress hooks
  • Hello Elementor theme location support built-in

Free Template Library

  • 9 instant-import premade templates across 5 categories — headers, footers, hero sections, pricing tables, and CTA banners
  • All templates use the modern Elementor Container (flexbox) system and are fully responsive
  • Fully editable after import — nothing is locked
  • New templates added with each release

Bundled Widgets

  • Nav Menu — dropdown-ready navigation widget, no Pro required
  • Site Logo — displays your custom logo or site name as a fallback

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • Elementor (free) 3.10+
  • PHP 7.4+

Compatibility

  • Works with Elementor free — Elementor Pro is NOT required
  • Uses the modern Flexbox Container layout system (Elementor 3.6+)
  • Tested with Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, and Blocksy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Install and activate Elementor (free) if not already active.
  4. Go to MerKit Addons -> Templates to browse and import templates.
  5. Go to MerKit Addons -> Theme Builder to create or assign header/footer templates.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. This plugin works entirely with the free version of Elementor.

Does this work with the new Elementor Container (Flexbox) system?

Yes. All bundled templates use the modern Container layout. Legacy Section/Column layouts are not used.

Which themes does the Theme Builder support?

All classic themes. The plugin implements Elementor’s theme-location system — the same mechanism Elementor Pro uses — so themes with native Elementor support (Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Neve, and many more) automatically replace their own header/footer with yours. Themes without location support are handled through a header/footer template override. No manual theme settings needed.

Are the templates really free?

Yes. All templates included in the plugin are free, with no upsells or locked items.

Can I add my own templates?

Yes. Go to MerKit Addons -> Theme Builder and use Import Template from JSON to upload a template exported from this plugin or from Elementor (.json). You can also Export any of your templates back to a JSON file from the same page — handy for backups or moving a template between sites. After importing, every template is fully editable in Elementor.

How do I embed a template in a post or page?

Use the shortcode: [merkit_template id=”123″] — replace 123 with the template post ID shown in the Theme Builder admin page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Theme Builder with display conditions (header, footer, block)
  • Template Library with 9 bundled templates (headers, footers, heroes, pricing table, CTA banners)
  • Template import/export (.json) — bring your own templates or back yours up
  • In-editor template library button — insert templates without leaving Elementor
  • Nav Menu widget (sticky header, hover animations, dropdowns, mobile panel styling controls)
  • Site Logo widget
